classifications.reason: Rows are emitted in unique path order.

experiment.reason: Git supplies the changed-file order, so caller input cannot reorder this path in isolation.

classifications.reason: Capabilities are sorted by stable capability id.
The first candidate that resolves and states its identity is selected.
Argument order is part of the invoked identity command.
Probe order records candidate evaluation in declaration order.

experiment.reason: Probe order is derived from candidate order, so changing it through the compiler also changes candidates and is not isolated.

classifications.reason: Argument order records the identity command that selected the candidate.

experiment.reason: Selected identity arguments are derived from declared identity arguments, so changing them through the compiler also changes their source array.

classifications.reason: Attempts are restricted to documented fields and sorted by stable attempt identity.
